eligibilityReason: Requires a damaging skill; Lily and Zero have one in the current simulator.
The Ultimate is guaranteed to crit with +50 percentage points of Critical Damage and restores 20 Energy; then cools down for one wearer turn. Dawn’s current Ultimate deals no damage.
Ultimate use advances the wearer by 100% and restores 30 Energy; then cools down for two wearer turns.
Defense ignore works with the current damage model; the +10% bonus applies to physical and magical damage.

After a skill, grants a shield equal to 10% of Max HP for two wearer turns, then enters cooldown for the next two wearer turns. Reflect increases by 10 percentage points while the wearer has any shield.
Triggers on Ultimate use; support Ultimates also trigger it.
After a skill, restores one skill point and 10 Energy; then cools down for the wearer’s next two turns.
Triggers on the wearer’s basic attack.
